note.zh-TW: 教材的列名「支付利息」直譯自日文支払利息，指的是費用；現行用語是利息費用，報表列名是財務成本。T11 回覆後再定主要顯示。
note.en: The course line name is a direct translation of the Japanese for interest expense; the current term is interest expense and the statement line is finance costs. The main display will be settled after T11.

definition.zh-TW: 借款在本期產生的利息費用，不論是否已經付現。實際付出的利息另外列在現金流量表的利息支出。
definition.en: The interest cost of borrowings for the period, whether or not it has been paid. The cash actually paid is shown separately as interest paid in the statement of cash flows.
